Placement map: where nextpnr put every cell on the XC7A200T

Every LUT, FF, CARRY4, IO and clock buffer of a real nextpnr-xilinx run, drawn on its site of the Artix-7 200T die. Drop your routed JSON and it draws yours.

A file you open here is read by your browser only: it is never uploaded. The page sets no cookie and sends nothing anywhere.

Where the numbers come from
  • gHashTag/trinity-fpga de4ebda367: fpga/openxc7-synth/trinity_v3_jtaguart.v and jtaguart.xdc
  • yosys 0.67+post (b8e7da6f40) synth_xilinx, then nextpnr-xilinx 0.9.2-107-g7037c948 --chipdb xc7a200tfbg676-1.bin --freq 50 --seed 1 --write routed.json
  • prjxray-db 517d66a383 artix7/xc7a200t/tilegrid.json: tile columns and site-to-grid maps
  • scripts/widget-data/fpga-pnr.py: placement.json, commands and input sha256 inside it
  • A routed nextpnr-xilinx JSON the reader drops or picks: read in the browser with FileReader, never uploaded
